blocks.prompt: 11 (a) A person standing 20 meters away from the base of a tree measures the angle of elevation to the top of the tree as \(30^\circ\). Find the height of the tree.
blocks.explanation:
Yeh oonchai wala seedha sa sawal hai: darakht, zameen aur nazar ki line mil kar ek right triangle banate hain.
Diya kya hai? Darakht se fasla 20 m aur angle of elevation (zameen se ooper dekhne ka angle) \(30^\circ\).
Find kya karna hai? Darakht ki oonchai \(h\).
Plan: \(\tan 30^\circ = \frac{h}{20}\) likh kar \(h\) nikalna.
steps:
Diya gaya: fasla 20 m, angle of elevation \(30^\circ\).
Maloom karna: darakht ki oonchai \(h\).
Tareeqa: Right triangle mein oonchai angle ke saamne (opposite) hai aur zameen wala fasla saath (adjacent). Opposite aur adjacent dono ka taluq \(\tan\) jorta hai, is liye \(\tan\) lagayenge.

Equation banayein
\[\tan 30^\circ = \dfrac{h}{20}\]
Kyun: \(\tan(\text{angle}) = \frac{\text{opposite}}{\text{adjacent}}\). Hypotenuse (nazar ki line) humein na di gayi hai na chahiye, is liye sin ya cos nahi.

\(h\) nikalein
\[h = 20\tan 30^\circ = \dfrac{20}{\sqrt{3}}\]
\[h = \dfrac{20\sqrt{3}}{3} \approx 11.55 \text{ m}\]
Kyun: Dono taraf 20 se multiply kiya. \(\tan 30^\circ = \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}\) yaad rakhne wali value hai. Phir \(\sqrt{3}\) ko neeche se hatane ke liye ooper neeche \(\sqrt{3}\) se multiply kiya (rationalise), aur \(\sqrt{3} \approx 1.732\) rakha.
Dhyan dein: \(\tan 30^\circ\) ko \(\sqrt{3}\) samajh lena aam ghalti hai; \(\sqrt{3}\) to \(\tan 60^\circ\) hai.

Tasdeeq
\[\tan^{-1}\tfrac{11.547}{20} = \tan^{-1}0.577 = 30^\circ\]
Kyun: Oonchai se wapas wohi \(30^\circ\) angle mila, to jawab sahi hai.
blocks.final_answer:
Darakht ki oonchai \(h = \frac{20}{\sqrt{3}} \approx 11.55\) m
Yani darakht takreeban saarhe gyarah meter ooncha hai.

blocks.prompt: 11 (b) A person standing 20 meters away from the base of a tree measures the angle of elevation to the top of the tree as \(30^\circ\). If the person walks 10 meters closer to the tree, what will be the new angle of elevation to the top of the tree?
blocks.explanation:
Ab banda darakht ki taraf 10 m chal kar qareeb aa gaya hai. Darakht ki oonchai wohi hai, sirf fasla badla hai: \(20 - 10 = 10\) m.
Diya kya hai? \(h \approx 11.55\) m (part (a) se) aur naya fasla 10 m.
Find kya karna hai? Naya angle of elevation \(\alpha\).
Plan: \(\tan\alpha = \frac{h}{10}\), phir \(\tan^{-1}\) se angle.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(h = \frac{20}{\sqrt{3}} \approx 11.55\) m (part (a)); naya fasla \(20 - 10 = 10\) m.
Maloom karna: naya angle of elevation \(\alpha\).
Tareeqa: Wohi right triangle wala tareeqa, bas ab adjacent side 10 m hai.

Equation banayein
\[\tan\alpha = \dfrac{h}{10} = \dfrac{20/\sqrt{3}}{10}\]
\[\tan\alpha = \dfrac{2}{\sqrt{3}} \approx 1.1547\]
Kyun: Opposite ab bhi darakht ki oonchai \(h\) hai aur adjacent naya fasla 10 m. Exact value \(\frac{20}{\sqrt{3}}\) rakhi taake rounding ki ghalti na aaye.
Dhyan dein: Fasla 10 m hai, 30 m nahi; banda qareeb gaya hai, door nahi.

Angle nikalein
\[\alpha = \tan^{-1}(1.1547)\]
\[\alpha \approx 49.11^\circ \approx 49.1^\circ\]
Kyun: Angle of elevation hamesha acute (\(90^\circ\) se kam) hota hai, is liye \(\tan^{-1}\) seedha sahi angle deta hai. Calculator degree mode mein.

Tasdeeq
\[10\tan 49.11^\circ = 10(1.1547) = 11.55\]
Kyun: Wapas darakht ki wohi oonchai mili. Aur yeh samajh mein bhi aata hai: qareeb ja kar ooper dekhne ke liye sar zyada uthana parta hai, is liye angle \(30^\circ\) se barh kar \(49.1^\circ\) ho gaya.
blocks.final_answer:
Naya angle of elevation \(\alpha = \tan^{-1}\frac{2}{\sqrt{3}} \approx 49.1^\circ\)
Yani qareeb jane se angle takreeban \(19^\circ\) barh gaya.
